consequence.statement: MESH_EXTERNAL services will use Destination Rule certificates instead of metadata certificates by default. This changes TLS certificate handling behavior for external services unless the environment variable is explicitly set to false.
consequence.remediation: Set PREFER_DESTINATIONRULE_TLS_FOR_EXTERNAL_SERVICES to 'false' to retain the previous metadata certificate behavior.

original.statement: Istio 1.24.0 adds support for using Destination Rule certificates instead of metadata certificates for MESH_EXTERNAL services, controlled via the PREFER_DESTINATIONRULE_TLS_FOR_EXTERNAL_SERVICES environment variable.

decision.reason: [ev-790b038b82b7] says Istio now uses DestinationRule certificates instead of metadata certificates for MESH_EXTERNAL services. It also says this can be reverted by setting PREFER_DESTINATIONRULE_TLS_FOR_EXTERNAL_SERVICES to false, which means the new behaviour is the default. The evidence doesn't say that anything fails, is rejected or stops being honoured, so behavior-change (a review item) fits. The proposed statement and remediation match the text.
